blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Marcos on Sunday greeted Wilfredo “Tata Willy” Avila, a longtime photographer of the Marcos family who celebrated his 89th birthday. In his latest vlog on Sunday, Marcos made a special mention of Avila, describing him as a family member who had been with them through decades of political highs and lows. The President said Avila was also a September birthday celebrant, along with him (Sept. 13), his sister Irene (Sept. 16) and their father, the late President Ferdinand Marcos Sr. (Sept. 11).
